lines.text: باشد بسبب اختلاف منظر الابصار و خسوف قمر را مکث باشد یعنی درنگ و افتابرا مکث نباشد
lines.en: It is due to the parallax of vision. And the lunar eclipse has a duration, meaning a delay, and the solar eclipse does not have a duration.

lines.text: و از جانب مغرب بگیرد و هم از جانب مغرب کشادن گیرد زیرا که جرم ماه از افتاب کوچکتر است
lines.en: And it begins from the west and also clears from the west, because the body of the moon is smaller than the sun.

lines.text: و سبک روتر و از افتاب زود بگذرد و منجمان طالع وسط خسوف بیرون ارند و از وی
lines.en: And it is faster and passes the sun quickly. And astrologers extract the ascendant of the middle of the eclipse, and from it

lines.text: احکام سازند و هر ساعت خسوف را ماهی تاثیر نویسند و هر ساعت کسوف را سالی تاثیر
lines.en: they make judgments. And for every hour of the lunar eclipse they write a month of influence, and for every hour of the solar eclipse a year of influence.

lines.text: گویند بشرط انکه شهری بود که منسوب بود ببرج کسوف
lines.en: They say, provided that it is a city that is attributed to the sign of the eclipse.

sections.text: مگر انکه در راس و ذنب باشد
sections.en: Unless it is at the head or tail (nodes).

summary.headline: Eclipse Duration and Influence
summary.text: Astrological rules for lunar and solar eclipses: their apparent motion, duration, westward beginning and clearing, the use of the eclipse midpoint ascendant for judgment, and the lunar-month versus solar-year durations of influence for cities associated with the eclipse sign.
